analogy.rationale: SLC12A5 (KCC2) is a neuronal K-Cl cotransporter with negligible expression in these non-neuronal cell lines, so the drug should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other ion transport/channel modulators, especially the related sodium/potassium/chloride transporter inhibitor class.
